notes: This is the wired G502 Proteus Spectrum record order for product 0xC332. It shares the physical button order with G502 HERO and G502 LIGHTSPEED; do not reuse it for G502 X, which moves the DPI and tilt records.
Validated on the wired G502 Spectrum (product 0xC332): four 11-byte legacy onboard RGB records begin at offset 208, with Logo and DPI-indicator zones. Only the three-byte solid-color field is edited.
Zone indexes were confirmed against the physical LEDs: index 0 drives the Logo LED, index 1 drives the DPI-indicator LED (this was previously reversed).

Captured 2026-09 by factory-resetting a wired G502 Proteus Spectrum (0xC332, G HUB internal model id 'g502_spectrum') from Logitech G HUB and reading back the resulting state; G HUB marks this data read-only, matching a manufacturer default rather than a user edit.

Button raw records reuse this file's own buttonRecord encoding (see profileIO.layout): G1-G5 are mouse-button clicks, G6 is DPI Shift (hold-to-lower/'sniper'), G7/G8 are DPI down/up, G9/G10 are wheel tilt left/right, G9-profile (button 11) cycles the onboard profile.

RGB zone colors are intentionally omitted here: G HUB's default effect is a full-brightness rainbow cycle, and the color bytes a real device stores while cycling were never directly observed, so only the verified effect mode is recorded. The mode byte position/values (0x03 = cycle) come from this codebase's own profile_codec_rgb_mode_is_known validation, not from G HUB.
